summary: Valneva SE filed a routine Form 6-K attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated November 4, 2026, announcing that it will report nine-month 2026 consolidated financial results on November 24, 2026, with a webcast at 3 p.m. CET / 9 a.m. ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the release is an earnings-calendar notice plus boilerplate company description and forward-looking statements. The filing is incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-3 shelf. What to watch: the November 24 results and business update, notably Lyme and Shigella program progress; no risk-arb angle applies.
